verdict.rationale: Cline's pricing page says users are "never locked into our platform or pricing" and can "switch providers or self-host anytime." BYOK and local-model support back up the ability to leave. However, nothing in the evidence documents exporting user data such as task/conversation history, settings or account data, or any open export format. missing for 10: documented data/history export feature, specification of open export formats, account-data portability docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of exit/export.
